title: Remove all Rust compiler warnings from the termal build (dead code and an unread field), without breaking in-flight changes
outcome: cargo check --bin termal and the test build of the termal binary compile with zero warnings, and no warning-suppression attribute hides a real warning.
acceptance: For each warning, a note records whether the item is truly dead on current master AND in every queued READY patch, or is used by one of them; truly dead code is removed, and code needed by a queued patch is left for that patch (its warning disappears when the patch lands) or is wired correctly.
cargo check --bin termal and the termal test build report zero warnings on the exact final input; no blanket allow(dead_code) or other suppression is added to hide them.
The independent review pair finds no Medium or higher, and the maintained full gate passes on the exact landed tree.
